First, note that $x=-3$ cannot be a solution since division by $0$ is undefined. 

To solve the equation, we first apply cross-multiplication:

$$
\eqalign{
	\dfrac{2}{4x+12} &= \dfrac{2}{x+3} \	
	2 \cdot (x+3) &= (4x+12) \cdot 2 \
	2x + 6 &= 8x + 24
	}
$$

Then, we apply the addition and multiplication principles, as usual:

$$
\eqalign{
	2x + 6 &= 8x + 24 \
	2x + 6-24 &= 8x + 24-24 \
	2x-18 &= 8x \
	2x-18-2x &= 8x-2x \
	-18 &= 6x \
        \dfrac{-18}{6} &= \dfrac{6x}{6} \
        -3 &= x
	}
$$

Since $x=-3$ cannot be a solution, the equation has **no solutions.**
